description:
The Kafka service is configured to use Kerberos authentication with the client SASL Kerberos service name set to **kafka** and the SASL mechanism **GSSAPI**. Communication with the brokers will occur over **SASL_SSL**, and Kerberos is enabled, referencing the secrets **kafka-jaas-secret**, **kafka-keytab-secret**, and **kafka-krb5-secret** for JAAS configuration, the keytab, and the krb5 config respectively. The Zookeeper endpoint for Kafka is **master.mesos:2181/dcos-service-confluent-kafka**.

The Schema Registry is deployed under the service name **schema-registry**, with a single instance allocated **2 CPU units**, **1024 MB** of memory, and a JVM heap of **512 MB**. It runs on all nodes (role “*”) and is attached to the virtual network **dcos**, which is enabled. The listener protocol is **https**, requiring client authentication (SSL client auth is enabled). Access‑Control settings allow the methods **GET,POST,PUT,DELETE** from any origin (“*”). The registry uses the keystore secret **registry-keystore-secret** and supports the following cipher suites: TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384. Registry data is stored in Zookeeper under the namespace **dcos-service-confluent-kafka/schema-registry**.
